about: The workcenter's own rules for a board's legend (tools/legend.py). The least height and stroke of a text are not here: each comes from the fab's rule set in rules/, read from its own page. The numbers here are the workcenter's choices, from no standard; each says why.

designator_reach_mm.why: A designator further than this from its own part's courtyard is not taken as its part's. The KiCad library puts a 0603's designator 0.125 mm off its courtyard and a header's 0.035 mm off; 2.0 mm leaves room for a placed one and is less than a 0603's length and a half.

placer_gap_mm.why: The gap the placer leaves between a designator's box and its own part's courtyard.

size_step_mm.why: The step the placer makes a designator smaller by, down to the fab's least height.

directions_per_side.why: The owner's word of 2026-11-17: text in more than 2 directions on 1 side is hard to read. A text at 180 degrees is a direction of its own: kicad-cli 10 plots a gr_text "L" at 180 upside down, its foot at the top.
